4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: After our meeting with Gloria Tory, and further discussions with the party and my cabinet, it was time to talk to Albin Clavin to get the reformist wing to support the proposal.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: I also planned to finally present a more fleshed out proposal and declare our agenda to the party after our meeting.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I walked into the left wing of the Assembly and entered the quarters of the USP. When I reached the meeting hall, I saw many of our members conversing inside.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: After taking a glimpse inside, I went back into the corridor to look for the office of Albin Clavin, which was around the back of the place.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: When I reached his room, I knocked on his door and entered.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: The whole room was surrounded by bookshelves packed with files and papers. It was a small office, with books and dossiers lying on every corner. It felt claustrophobic.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: On his gesture, I took a seat.

12.speaker: Player
12.text: "Did a bomb drop in this office?"

14.speaker: Albin Clavin
14.text: "It's been busy. The party has been working very hard, Mr. President. Thank you for asking."

15.speaker: Albin Clavin
15.text: "How is it going for you in the Palace?"

17.speaker: Albin Clavin
17.text: "So much research and preparation needs to be done on the plans we're working on."

18.speaker: Albin Clavin
18.text: "How is everything going for you, Mr. President?"

22.speaker: Albin Clavin
22.text: "Oh, I see. Then I'll try my best not to make it any worse for you, Mr. President."

23.speaker: Albin Clavin
23.text: "I can't imagine the work you're dealing with up there."

25.speaker: Albin Clavin
25.text: "Anyway, sir, let's talk about the proposal. Thanks for coming here for my input because there are some subjects where Gloria and I don't see eye to eye."

26.speaker: Albin Clavin
26.text: "I have to say that most of the progressives were already starting to warm up to you. Your attempt at changing the constitution created quite a bit of excitement. One could dare to say an excitement that hasn't been felt since the 30's..."

27.speaker: Albin Clavin
27.text: "Yet, there are some issues with the current status of the draft proposal. So we may need to contain our excitement a little longer."
27.conditionsRaw:
((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == false  and  
Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == false) == false) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false)

28.speaker: Albin Clavin
28.text: "I've read the proposal that was finalised together with Mrs. Tory. And surprisingly, it came out pretty good."
28.conditionsRaw:
(Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == false  and  
Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true)

29.speaker: Albin Clavin
29.text: "I have to say that the proposal is unacceptable in its current state."

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: I went to the restaurant of the Assembly to get something to eat while conversing with other members of our party.

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: I saw Albin talking to his people in the distance.

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: After a while, the preparations for the conference began and I went back into the conference hall and prepared my notes for the speech I was going to make.

34.speaker: Narrator
34.text: It took time to get all of the present members of the party inside the hall. Gloria Tory announced me from the stand.

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: I walked up to the stand as everybody in the room started clapping.

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: I started my speech with the reasons of the changes to the Constitution.

41.speaker: Player
41.text: "Our system and institutions have increasingly became undemocratic..."

42.speaker: Player
42.text: "The Supreme Court is blocking the future of Sordland..."

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: I paused as they started clapping and continued.

44.speaker: Narrator
44.text: I paused when some people started clapping but it was short lived. After taking a breath, I continued.

46.speaker: Player_Italic
46.text: Talk about why USP needs this to survive the next elections.

47.speaker: Player_Italic
47.text: Target the Old Guards and the Supreme Court.

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: A round of applause from the left was heard.

52.speaker: Narrator
52.text: The left side of the hall where Albin sat started applauding.

53.speaker: Narrator
53.text: The moderates that sat in the centre started applauding.

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: Later I explained the contents of the new Constitution and asked for their full support for the proposal.

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: The reformist wing on the left stood up and started clapping loudly after Albin Clavin made a sign.

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: Soon after, most of the party members stood up and joined in.

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: The conservatives on the right side of the hall where Gloria sat stood up and started clapping loudly after I saw Gloria making a gesture with her hands.

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: There wasn't much reaction from the party.

68.speaker: Narrator
68.text: I saluted everybody in the room one last time and bid them farewell before leaving the stand.

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: I walked outside the Assembly and back into the Palace...

104.speaker: Albin Clavin
104.text: "I cannot support this in its current state."

105.speaker: Albin Clavin
105.text: "I suspect that Mrs. Tory had a lot of influence on this proposal. But I cannot support this in its current state."

111.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
111.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true

112.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false

113.speaker: Albin Clavin
113.text: "That would have been very nice for you, wouldn't it, Mr. President?"

114.speaker: Albin Clavin
114.text: "With all due respect, maybe you shouldn't forget that it is the party that made you president."

117.speaker: Albin Clavin
117.text: "But us democrats have already established our demands, which were apparently ignored by you."

118.speaker: Albin Clavin
118.text: "You cannot claim that you're the democrat here."

119.speaker: Albin Clavin
119.text: "But at this point, even my support would not be enough."

120.speaker: Albin Clavin
120.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true

124.speaker: Player
124.text: "Don't forget who you are speaking to."

126.speaker: Player
126.text: "Tell me the issues. How can I get your support?"

127.speaker: Albin Clavin
127.text: "This proposal will have hard time getting support in its current status. You surely know that."

128.speaker: Albin Clavin
128.text: "You are sabotaging yourself if you're not willing to listen the reformists in your own party..."

129.speaker: Albin Clavin
129.text: "First, I'll say that I'm concerned about the drastic decrease in the threshold. The reformist wing of the party will do its best to boycott it."
129.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false)

130.speaker: Albin Clavin
130.text: "That will have negative consequences for our party since dozens of parties could potentially enter the parliament. The electoral finance reform reduces their ability to campaign but nonetheless the situation won't be in our favour at all."

131.speaker: Albin Clavin
131.text: "We have specifically asked for a change in appointment of ministers. This is what the party was expecting."
131.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true) == false)

132.speaker: Narrator
132.text: He paused and twiddled his thumbs.

133.speaker: Albin Clavin
133.text: "Yet I see that our suggestions were completely ignored."

134.speaker: Albin Clavin
134.text: "Excuse me, Mr. President, but how are they not ignored?"

138.speaker: Albin Clavin
138.text: "I don't know what I can do for you even if I gave you my support. The party will not like this."

139.speaker: Albin Clavin
139.text: "Who's us? Isn't the party included in that now?"

141.speaker: Player
141.text: "Gloria and the conservatives didn't seem to have any problems with it."

142.speaker: Albin Clavin
142.text: "What is that supposed to mean? *We* have a problem with it."

144.speaker: Albin Clavin
144.text: "Here. I already have my suggestion here."

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: He pulled out a stack of papers and placed them on his desk.

147.speaker: Narrator
147.text: The papers contained suggested amendments to the Constitution.

148.speaker: Narrator
148.text: I skimmed through the law he pointed out. "Council of Ministers are formed upon the President's appointment of them from a list of nominees that the Grand National Assembly selects."

149.speaker: Player
149.text: "Leave the rest of the party to me. I am now asking for *your* support."

150.speaker: Player
150.text: "We can add the requested change to the proposal."

152.speaker: Albin Clavin
152.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false

153.speaker: Albin Clavin
153.text: "Your proposal will be crushed like this anyway. I'd rather have something tangible to support."

154.speaker: Albin Clavin
154.text: "First of all, we are concerned about where this proposal is heading."
154.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true) == false)

155.speaker: Albin Clavin
155.text: "It aims to give you absolute immunity with no way of impeachment."

159.speaker: Albin Clavin
159.text: "But never mind that now. There are far worse problems. We are not sure where this proposal is heading."

160.speaker: Albin Clavin
160.text: "I thought you were one of us. Against Sollism and the concentration of power. This is wrong."

161.speaker: Player
161.text: "I am against Sollism. This law is necessary to protect me from the Court."

162.speaker: Player
162.text: "I'm sure we can work something out."

164.speaker: Player
164.text: "I'm open to discuss changes but not to this law."

165.speaker: Albin Clavin
165.text: "It will not only protect you but also your successors, Mr. President. This law has the potential to create another Soll."

169.speaker: Narrator
169.text: He raised an eyebrow and then frowned at me.

170.speaker: Albin Clavin
170.text: "So you want to hear our concerns or you are only here to push your agenda?"

171.speaker: Player
171.text: "I'm sure we can work out *something else*."

173.speaker: Albin Clavin
173.text: "This isn't how you *curb* the power of the Old Guards... This proposal instead gives more power to the executive. How is this any better than before?"

179.speaker: Albin Clavin
179.text: "You are removing the Justices' immunity and giving it to yourself. This is borderline dictatorial since you can also replace them at your whim. Did you forget that we are democrats at heart, Mr. President?"

183.speaker: Albin Clavin
183.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true)

184.speaker: Albin Clavin
184.text: "You are giving yourself absolute immunity and still keeping your extensive decree powers. Who do you think we are to support such changes, Mr. President?"

188.speaker: Albin Clavin
188.text: "That is not a good start. But let's look at the other issues first then."
188.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true  or Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true)

189.speaker: Albin Clavin
189.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true  or Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true  or Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true) == false)

196.speaker: Albin Clavin
196.text: "As long as this law and the threshold remains, I don't think I can give you my support."

197.speaker: Albin Clavin
197.text: "As much as I want to give you my support, you are forcing our hand with this proposal..."

198.speaker: Player
198.text: "It isn't about more powers, it is only protection."

199.speaker: Player
199.text: "Okay, let's change this law." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

200.speaker: Player
200.text: "I'm open to discuss changes but not to this law."

201.speaker: Albin Clavin
201.text: "I understand where you're coming from but us reformists cannot agree to this change. This is the very political culture that we are fighting against."

202.speaker: Albin Clavin
202.text: "Let's say we trust you and you become the greatest leader ever lived. And then, what happens when you leave office?"

205.speaker: Albin Clavin
205.text: "Reformists were expecting a reform about the term limits. Why is that not included in the proposal?"
205.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true) == false)

206.speaker: Albin Clavin
206.text: "Oh yeah? What do you have in mind?"

207.speaker: Player
207.text: "Let's remove the change from the proposal." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

208.speaker: Player
208.text: "Maybe I can help you some other way..."

213.speaker: Albin Clavin
213.text: "It seems you have interesting dreams. But dreams, nonetheless."

214.speaker: Albin Clavin
214.text: "I would have understood your stance if this was the only issue... There are more."

218.speaker: Albin Clavin
218.text: "I think you're pushing your luck too much, Mr. President."
218.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true)

219.speaker: Albin Clavin
219.text: "You know... This isn't the only issue. There's another one."

220.speaker: Albin Clavin
220.text: "At least you decided to make some democratic changes to the term limits, Mr. President."
220.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true) == false)

223.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
223.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false

225.speaker: Player
225.text: "This is only my first term. It's too soon to bring term limits."

227.speaker: Albin Clavin
227.text: "So, you also want to use the flaws of the system for your own benefit."

229.speaker: Albin Clavin
229.text: "What is a priority for you, Mr. President?"

230.speaker: Albin Clavin
230.text: "I thought there would be some reform about the extensive decree powers..."
230.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Stronger"] == true) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true) == false)

231.speaker: Narrator
231.text: He stared directly into my eyes.

233.speaker: Player
233.text: "There isn't going to be reforms about the decrees."

234.speaker: Player
234.text: "Look. We need the decrees to pass further reforms. I can't give away everything."

244.speaker: Player_Italic
244.text: Change the proposal accordingly. [CHANGE THE REFORM]

245.speaker: Player
245.text: "On a second thought, I won't change this."

246.speaker: Player
246.text: "Limiting the legislative powers of the Supreme Court."

261.speaker: Albin Clavin
261.text: "And you're doing more than that, aren't you? Taking away the immunity of the Justices and giving the power to impeach to the parliament which our, or should I say, your party controls."
261.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true)

262.speaker: Albin Clavin
262.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Presidents"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true) == false)

266.speaker: Albin Clavin
266.text: "By giving yourself the same rights as Soll?"

267.speaker: Albin Clavin
267.text: "Do you want me to believe that?"

268.speaker: Albin Clavin
268.text: "Could you tell me... What is your priority with this proposal?"

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: He let out a fake laughter.

270.speaker: Albin Clavin
270.text: "Let's see then... There is one more problem."

278.speaker: Albin Clavin
278.text: "Let's see then... What are you thinking about?"

281.speaker: Player
281.text: "On a second thought, I'd rather not include any changes to term limits."

282.speaker: Albin Clavin
282.text: "I told you. This is a power grab. I can't support this."

283.speaker: Albin Clavin
283.text: "You should at least do something about term limits."

284.speaker: Albin Clavin
284.text: "You should at least do something about the threshold. The party will not like this."
284.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)

285.speaker: Albin Clavin
285.text: "We prefer some kind of reform. The president currently holds too much power."

286.speaker: Albin Clavin
286.text: "I suggest limiting the power of the decrees with an enabling act. The Assembly should have some control over a potential rogue president."

287.speaker: Albin Clavin
287.text: "And if you really care about further democratic reforms, we'll issue the enabling act. But we have to make sure the presidents can't work alone anymore."

535.text: "It's just that we thought the Palace wouldn't let us down."

536.speaker: Albin Clavin
536.text: "The businesses will share the burden with the state but it is a change they have to abide by."

537.speaker: Player
537.text: "The worker's revolution will begin with small steps."

538.speaker: Albin Clavin
538.text: "One would think that I'm talking to Ms. Walda. The party doesn't support such ideologies as you know."

539.speaker: Albin Clavin
539.text: "Personally there are some principles that I respect in Malenyevism but I wouldn't accept it in it's entirety."

540.speaker: Player
540.text: "It is a market economy with a free supply and demand system. The government shouldn't overregulate."

541.speaker: Albin Clavin
541.text: "The situation is borderline exploitative, that is why the majority of the assembly gathered behind it. The act was supposed to bring some regulation which didn't exist before."

545.speaker: Albin Clavin
545.text: "It wouldn't be possible without Paskal Beniwoll's support. The Labour Union and several NGO's like Magnus Cartus also contributed to the campaigning."

579.speaker: Albin Clavin
579.text: "First, I'll say that I'm concerned about the increase in the threshold. The reformist wing of the party will do its best to boycott that since the expectation from us is to democratise, not do the opposite."
579.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_Default"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)

584.speaker: Albin Clavin
584.text: "The change will have negative consequences for our party since dozens of new parties could potentially enter the parliament."

588.speaker: Albin Clavin
588.text: "Combined with the electoral finance reform no other party can ever make it to the parliament. Our constituents wouldn't accept the situation."

595.speaker: Player
595.text: "Fine. I will remove the increase in the threshold."

599.speaker: Albin Clavin
599.text: "You are removing the Justices' immunity and giving the ability to impeach it to the parliament. I'm a parliamentarian at heart and while I think this strengthens the people's representative power, it still is wrong."

600.speaker: Albin Clavin
600.text: "Who do you think we are to support such changes, Mr. President?"

601.speaker: Player
601.text: " I will remove the changes to the immunity of the Justices." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

606.speaker: Albin Clavin
606.text: "And you're doing more than that, aren't you? Taking away the immunity of the Justices and giving the power to replace them to yourself. A worrying notion."
606.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_Assembly"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Judges_Impeachment_President"] == true)

607.speaker: Player
607.text: "I will remove the decrease in the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]
607.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Law_Threshold_Default"] == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true)

608.speaker: Player
608.text: "I will remove the increase in the threshold." [CHANGE THE REFORM]
608.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_15"] == true)  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Law_Threshold_Default"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Threshold_3"] == true) == false)

615.speaker: Albin Clavin
615.text: "This particular change is specifically worrying as it represents an opposite trend. The decrees need to be weaker not stronger."

616.speaker: Player
616.text: "To truly reform the country the President needs decrees not subject to review."

617.speaker: Player
617.text: "What is wrong with a USP President having strong decree powers?"

618.speaker: Player
618.text: "I respect the perspective of the reformist wing."

619.speaker: Albin Clavin
619.text: "What I didn't expect was a worsening of the current situation. Presidential decrees above statute law and not subject to judicial review... It would destroy the separation of powers."

620.speaker: Albin Clavin
620.text: "And the attempt to offset this by adding an override of the veto power to the parliament only to have no time limit to act is a very low move. Tricks like this won't go unnoticed."

621.speaker: Albin Clavin
621.text: "I thought you wanted to discuss a change..."

623.speaker: Player
623.text: "Fine. Let's change the law and limit the decrees." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

626.speaker: Player
626.text: "I can't let the Assembly control me."

628.speaker: Player
628.text: "I don't trust the Assembly to give me the power to enact major reforms though."

630.speaker: Player
630.text: "It makes sense. I will include your suggestion and limit the decrees." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

634.speaker: Player
634.text: "The fact that we are giving the Assembly the power to override a veto is change enough."

635.speaker: Albin Clavin
635.text: "You didn't include any time limit for that response thus creating a loophole which puts us back to square one. Nothing."

636.speaker: Albin Clavin
636.text: "And if you really care about further democratic reforms, we'll issue the enabling act. But we have to make sure the presidents can't work alone anymore."

637.speaker: Albin Clavin
637.text: "I suggest limiting the power of the decrees with an enabling act. The Assembly should have some control over a potential rogue president."

638.speaker: Albin Clavin
638.text: "Well there were some subjects that were wrong about Tarquin Soll and we don't want to see a repeat of that."

639.speaker: Albin Clavin
639.text: "Enough to make a slight change that would heavily influence our tendencies to support the draft?"

640.speaker: Albin Clavin
640.text: "Why can't the President work closely with the Assembly?"

647.speaker: Albin Clavin
647.text: "Which under this draft proposal also would have immunity for life once retired."

648.speaker: Albin Clavin
648.text: "And your abolishment of the honorary membership indicates that you are a democrat too."

649.speaker: Albin Clavin
649.text: "But the extent of your democratic beliefs matter."

653.speaker: Albin Clavin
653.text: "The removal of the honorary membership won't be respected by the party either."

657.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
657.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Default"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Assembly"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Weaker"] == true) == false

696.speaker: Player
696.text: "I wouldn't mind if my next Vice President had a bit more... funds. [Show him a cheque]"

697.speaker: Narrator
697.text: I took out a cheque and showed it to him. It immediately got his attention.

698.speaker: Albin Clavin
698.text: "You certainly know how to make compelling arguments, don't you Mr. President?"

699.speaker: Narrator
699.text: He took the cheque and slid it into the pocket of his jacket.

700.speaker: Albin Clavin
700.text: "Glad to be making business with you."

708.speaker: Player
708.text: "I will give the Assembly the power to nominate the ministers." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

709.speaker: Player
709.text: "I will remove the changes to the immunity of the President." [CHANGE THE REFORM]

715.speaker: Narrator
715.text: He took a deep breath then let out a long sigh.

716.speaker: Player
716.text: "On a second thought, I'm fine with the current draft."
